mechanism: Ritonavir is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that may reduce oxacillin metabolism and increase oxacillin levels, while oxacillin may induce CYP3A4 potentially reducing ritonavir concentrations.
action: Monitor clinical response and oxacillin efficacy; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of ritonavir levels; assess for oxacillin toxicity signs; alternative antibiotics may be preferred depending on indication.
